name: Defence / green-energy restructuring
thesis: Board-approved in-principle expansion of the proposed restructuring to include the defence/aerospace subsidiary alongside the green-energy subsidiary.
risks: The amalgamation is proposed, not completed; valuations, detailed terms, financial implications and further approvals remain unresolved.
Evidence supports company exposure and an actual board decision, not assured earnings accretion or a profitable trade.
Intraday disclosure: this is a narrative/volume-led EP, not an opening-gap catalyst.
Reviewed retrospectively using sources available before that session's close; not a backtest.

sources.title: Goodluck India: board outcome expands proposed restructuring to defence/aerospace and green energy
sources.summary: The primary filing records in-principle approval to include Goodluck Defence and Aerospace Limited, a material subsidiary, alongside Goodluck Green Energy Limited. Detailed terms and financial implications are to be evaluated and disclosed later.
sources.time_basis: Conservatively available by the CNBC report; not the exact exchange broadcast timestamp
rating_reasons: In-principle proposal approval; implementation and materiality remain conditional.

sources.title: Goodluck India board approves expanded restructuring including defence and aerospace
